text.p: These are the headlines selected from Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Chretien assailed over his record: PM fights back as leaders stress unity while squabbling over issues.
- Parizeau seeks separatist fervour: Former premier rallies sovereignists: Former premier rallies sovereignists.
- Plotted to kill Buthelezi ANC says: Plan overruled, commission told.
- Ottawa plans new strategy in campaign to save magazines: Tariff would be abandoned and investment rules changed.
- Deep Blue not a deep thinker: The lights may be on when the numbers are crunched, but there's nobody home.
- Firms rack up record profits: Low loan rates, hot U.S. economy cited in Globe survey's $6.9-billion first-quarter tally.
- Grand Met, Guiness to form $52-billion giant: British firms strengthen global reach.
- Regulators hot over financial advisers' Hawaii trip: Sponsorship by fund companies 'slap in the face' to OSC.
- Dow blasts to new high: Nears 7,300 after month's steep rise.
- De Guzman linked to lab: Before his death, Bre-X geologist was seen at least once a week at warehous where massive tampering with gold samples is thought to have place.
- Seagram cries foul over Guinness, Grand Met deal.
